Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the gathered data, claiming Ortaköy (location of Esma Sultan Mansion) is in the Fatih district and concluding the sites are in the same district. Ortaköy is actually in the Beşiktaş district, and the neighborhoods are different (Laleli vs. Ortaköy). This factual and logical error led to the wrong conclusion about whether they are in the same neighborhood.
